content_feed.headline: Endurance Technologies Commences Commercial Production at New AURIC Shendra Plant
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Commencement of commercial production at a new greenfield plant represents a material operational milestone.
content_feed.summary: On 25 September 2026, Endurance Technologies Limited announced that its newly constructed greenfield plant at AURIC Shendra, Chh. Sambhajinagar has commenced commercial production of aluminium die‑casting components for the automotive sector (ICE and EV) and non‑automotive applications. The facility has an initial installed capacity of 900 metric tonnes per month, with a planned expansion to 1,100 MT/month contingent on securing additional OEM orders. The plant’s design incorporates modular equipment to facilitate future capacity increases. No financial performance figures, order backlog, or customer details were disclosed in the filing.

facts.how_much: Initial capacity 900 MT/month, expandable to 1,100 MT/month
facts.what_changes: Greenfield manufacturing facility for aluminium die‑casting components, capacity expansion contingent on orders
facts.what_is_not_disclosed: Revenue, net profit, order backlog, customer list, and projected revenue impact

Historical order backlog and customer concentration in the automotive die‑casting segment
Market size and growth forecast for aluminium die‑casting components in India’s ICE and EV sectors

content_feed.headline: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Forms JV with TRL Krosaki Refractories
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Formation of joint venture indicates strategic expansion
content_feed.summary: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Limited (RPEL) and TRL Krosaki Refractories Limited (TRLK) incorporated a new private limited company, RPEL TRLK Silicatech Private Limited, in Odisha on 26 September 2026 under a joint venture agreement. The JV is set to develop, manufacture, and distribute silica ramming mass and other refractories, a business line outside RPEL’s core operations. The filing lists the JV’s turnover as nil and does not disclose the capital contribution, equity stake, or projected revenue. No financial impact on RPEL’s consolidated results is provided.

content_feed.summary: Servotech Renewable Power System Limited has introduced two new inverter products – an IP65 Hybrid Solar Inverter and an IP54 Hybrid Solar Inverter – along with a Micro Grid Inverter, on 27 September 2026.
